options.content: Pilots: Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · **Positions** · Ranks · Promotions | Events: Monday events | Management: Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace. Fixed periods and sizes, stated in each title; the page has no inputs. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, summed. A position is a callsign on the controller whitelist (only whitelisted callsigns are stored).

panels.title: Top 15 positions by hours staffed (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 15 positions (callsigns) with the most hours staffed in the last 30 days. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Ties: callsign A to Z. A position nobody staffed in the period is not listed (see the never-staffed list). Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sec AS (
  SELECT callsign, cid, greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(session_end, now()) - greatest(session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND session_start <= now()
)
SELECT callsign AS "Position", round(sum(secs) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours staffed"
FROM sec
GROUP BY callsign
HAVING sum(secs) > 0
ORDER BY sum(secs) DESC, callsign
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top 15 positions by sessions (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 15 positions (callsigns) with the most sessions that started in the last 30 days. There is no minimum length. Ties: callsign A to Z. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign AS "Position", count(*) AS "Sessions"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start >= now() - interval '30 days' AND session_start <= now()
GROUP BY callsign
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, callsign
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top 15 positions by different controllers (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 15 positions (callsigns) staffed by the most different controllers (distinct CIDs) in sessions that started in the last 30 days. No minimum length. Ties: callsign A to Z. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign AS "Position", count(DISTINCT cid) AS "Different controllers"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start >= now() - interval '30 days' AND session_start <= now()
GROUP BY callsign
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT cid) DESC, callsign
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top 15 airports by ATC hours staffed (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 15 airports with the most position-hours in the last 30 days. The airport is the callsign prefix before the first underscore or hyphen (SY for Sydney; AD-W_APP counts for AD); it is the prefix as written on the whitelist, not an ICAO code. Only airport positions count (_TWR, _APP, _DEP, _GND, _DEL); centre (_CTR), flight service (_FSS) and flow management (_FMP) are left out. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Two positions staffed together for 3 hours count as 6. Ties: prefix A to Z. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sec AS (
  SELECT callsign, cid, greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(session_end, now()) - greatest(session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND session_start <= now()
)
SELECT substring(callsign FROM '^[^_-]+') AS "Airport (callsign prefix)", round(sum(secs) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Position-hours"
FROM sec
WHERE callsign ~ '_(TWR|APP|DEP|GND|DEL)$'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(secs) > 0
ORDER BY sum(secs) DESC, 1
LIMIT 15

panels.title: CTR and FSS controllers active (30 days to month end, monthly)
panels.description: Per calendar month (UTC), distinct controllers who started a CTR or FSS session of more than 60 minutes in the 30 days before the end of that month; the latest month is partial; last 12 months. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_month,
         date_trunc('month', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_month
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
months AS (
  SELECT g.m AS month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 month') AS g(m)
  WHERE b.first_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start + interval '1 month' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.month_start + interval '1 month'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 60
      AND s.is_ctr_fss
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers active (30 days to week end, weekly)
panels.description: Per calendar week (UTC), distinct controllers (any position) who started a session of more than 30 minutes in the 30 days before the end of that week; the latest week is partial; last 12 months. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_week,
         date_trunc('week', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_week
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g.w AS week_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 week') AS g(w)
  WHERE b.first_week IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM weeks m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.week_start + interval '1 week' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.week_start + interval '1 week'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 30
GROUP BY m.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekdays (last 30 days)
panels.description: For each UTC clock hour, distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour over the last 30 days, Monday to Friday: pilots (flights with airborne time) and ATC (sessions of at least 20 minutes). Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 94: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 20
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekends (last 30 days)
panels.description: For each UTC clock hour, distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour over the last 30 days, Saturday and Sunday: pilots (flights with airborne time) and ATC (sessions of at least 30 minutes); a session across midnight is not counted after midnight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 95: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 30
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1
